Shabakah is a network security lab you SSH into. This release adds two lessons and new guide commands, makes the guide fully bilingual, rewrites the Arabic lessons as natural Arabic, and hardens the image.

## New

- **Two new lessons, seventeen in all.** Reading security headers (16) and scripted scanning with the Nmap Scripting Engine (17), each checked live.
- **`netsec next`** opens the lesson you have not finished, and the welcome line tells you which one it is.
- **`netsec certificate`** prints a completion certificate in English and Arabic once every lesson and flag is done.
- **`netsec reset`** clears progress for the next class.
- **Intel and ARM images.** The image now runs natively on Apple Silicon and other ARM machines, and it is tagged with its version as well as `latest`.

## Better in Arabic

- Every Arabic lesson was rewritten end to end as natural Arabic, and the website's Arabic side now shows real Arabic screenshots.
- The guide no longer falls back to English in Arabic mode, numbers and nouns agree, and answers accept Arabic digits.
- The capture the flag hunt is presented as التحديات with plain explanations of what a secret code is.

## Safer

- The practice services listen on loopback only and run as an unprivileged account, and only SSH is exposed.
- The image moved to Debian 13, pinned by digest, and workflow actions are pinned to commit SHAs.
- The guide keeps only digests of the flags, so reading its source no longer spoils the hunt.

## Fixed

- Submitting a flag in Arabic crashed the guide.
- Lesson 03 rejected a complete scan that included the console on port 2323.
- The UDP service always showed as down on the targets screen.
- The website and README listed lessons that did not match what the guide serves. They are now generated from the lesson files and checked in CI.

## Quick start

```
docker run -d --name shabakah --cap-add NET_ADMIN -p 2222:22 ghcr.io/siteq8/shabakah:1.3.0
ssh -p 2222 learner@localhost
```

The default password is `shabakah`. Switch to Arabic any time with `netsec lang ar`.
